title: Disentangling Monitor Hardware Artifacts and Smoothing Lag for Shift-Robust Intraoperative EEG and Hemodynamic Risk Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2611.25765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Commercial intraoperative electroencephalography (EEG) and blood pressure monitors introduce cyclic impedance pulses, smoothing delays, direct-current (DC) drift, and cuff holds that confound risk forecasting and uncertainty calibration. We developed a causal signal-conditioning and shift-robust conformal calibration framework across 5,439 public anesthesia procedures. Streaming filters blank 10.13-min 64-Hz impedance checks, apply unclipped post-notch conditioning, separate 63-s suppression-ratio lag, and distinguish three-channel cuff inflations from dropouts across propofol-remifentanil total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA; N = 3,214), volatile anesthesia (N = 2,046), European endoscopy sedation (N = 171), and DC-coupled surgery (N = 8). De-impedanced cortical tree ensembles were compared against deep sequence models, paired with patient-cluster Subgroup-Covariate-Weighted Conformal Risk Control (CRC) and lag-buffered online Conformal P

translated_title: 解耦监护仪硬件伪影与平滑滞后以实现分布偏移鲁棒的术中脑电与血流动力学风险校准
translated_abstract: 商用术中脑电图（EEG）和血压监护仪会引入周期性阻抗脉冲、平滑延迟、直流（DC）漂移和袖带保持等伪影，这些伪影会干扰风险预测与不确定性校准。我们基于5,439例公开麻醉手术记录，开发了一套因果信号调理与分布偏移鲁棒的保形校准框架。流式滤波器屏蔽10.13分钟时长的64 Hz阻抗检查，应用无削波的后陷波调理，分离63秒的抑制比滞后，并区分三通道袖带充气与信号脱落，覆盖丙泊酚-瑞芬太尼全静脉麻醉（TIVA；N=3,214）、挥发性麻醉（N=2,046）、欧洲内镜镇静（N=171）以及直流耦合手术（N=8）。研究将去除阻抗后的皮层树集成模型与深度序列模型进行比较，并与基于患者聚类的子群-协变量加权保形风险控制（CRC）以及滞后缓冲的在线保形预测方法相结合（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 针对商用术中监护仪的硬件伪影（阻抗脉冲、平滑延迟、直流漂移、袖带保持）干扰风险预测的问题，本文提出因果信号调理与分布偏移鲁棒的保形校准框架，在5,439例麻醉手术中实现了更可靠的术中脑电与血流动力学风险校准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a causal signal-conditioning and shift-robust conformal calibration framework that disentangles commercial monitor hardware artifacts (impedance pulses, smoothing lag, DC drift, cuff holds), enabling more reliable intraoperative EEG and hemodynamic risk calibration across 5,439 anesthesia procedures.
